1.title: US to announce deal allowing Saudi Arabia a nuclear programme
1.summary: The agreement would fulfil a long-held Saudi ambition but could attract concern in Israel and from some US lawmakers.

2.title: Wildfire Threatening Pleasanton Prompts Evacuation Order for Thousands
2.summary: One firefighter was injured as a fire spread quickly across dry hillsides in Northern California, forcing some residents to evacuate.

3.title: The Enduring Popularity of ‘The Surrendered Wife’
3.summary: The best-selling author Laura Doyle believes women can be too controlling. Many women — of all types — credit her with saving their marriages.

4.title: Modelling scout linked to Epstein found dead in Paris
4.summary: Daniel Siad, whose name appears in the Epstein files thousands of times, denied knowledge of the threat Jeffrey Epstein posed.

5.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russian online giant retailer Wildberries for second time
5.summary: Logistics hubs belonging to Wildberries in the Krasnodar and Stavropol regions were struck overnight.

6.title: Coveted U.S. Nuclear Deal Is a Coup for Saudi Crown Prince
6.summary: Saudi Arabia had for years sought the controversial deal to transfer American nuclear technology to the kingdom. It is expected to be sealed on Wednesday.
